title: Roswell ignored until Berlitz's 1980 book

tellings.quote: Ros Roswell as an incident didn't become a thing until 1980 [snorts] when the litz wrote his book about it and then Stanton Freeman and others got involved

plain: The skeptic writer Michael Shermer says the Roswell story, about something said to have crashed near Roswell, New Mexico, in 1947, was not a big deal for over thirty years. In his telling, it only "became a thing" in 1980, when the writer Charles Berlitz published his book The Roswell Incident, and the UFO researcher Stanton Friedman and others took it up. Shermer offers this as his own summary, to suggest the story grew from books rather than from 1947 itself.
